_comment: Accepted divergences from the Stitch designs. Each entry is a reviewed decision; anything not listed here fails verify:design-coverage.

allow.heading: Pine Crest Estates
allow.reason: Design sample-data property name. The properties grid is implemented and renders the user's REAL properties (name, address, units, occupancy, revenue) from GET /api/properties; a design fixture name can never appear for an arbitrary portfolio.

allow.heading: 2340 Maple Avenue
allow.reason: Design sample-data property address used as the detail heading. The detail page is implemented and renders the loaded property's real name and address from GET /api/properties/:id; the design's fixture address can never appear for an arbitrary id.

allow.heading: Leaky Faucet in Master
allow.reason: Design sample-data work-order title. The maintenance board is implemented and renders the user's REAL tickets (title, priority, property, unit, due date) from GET /api/maintenance; a design fixture title can never appear for an arbitrary account.
